statement: In the full-spread family, every frequency channel gives the same live contribution on a fixed output block: the all-ones vector across the 9 input fibers x 3 live summation coordinates.
The full-spread family has live-block column rank 1 per output block, whereas the target live block has fiber rank 9.
Therefore no sum of full-spread omega terms can realize the 3x3 multiplication tensor exactly, regardless of R.
